notes.title: Simplified Chinese version released! (Updated to ver. 1.30!)
notes.notes:
A Chinese (Simplified) translation mode has been added to “BLUE NIGHT LAUNDROMAT”!
We were able to implement it thanks to the kindness of our translator, Mr. Amei! Our sincere thanks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141361/18a4652d13874c1fc96b85d0bda51f1795184b56.png.

You can select “Chinese” on the language selection screen after starting the NEW GAME.

🌟Ver. 1.30 Other updates
Addition and correction of the wording and gimmicks related to solving the riddles in the game.
Fixed other minor typos and bugs.

notes.title: Version up ver.1.01！（ver.1.01にバージョンアップしました！）
notes.notes:
Updated to ver. 1.01, which fixes one bug by users(the bug that the screen choices before moving remain when moving screens) and other minor bugs reported.　Thank you for your report!


ご報告いただいたバグ1件(画面移動の際に、移動前の画面選択肢が残ってしまうバグ)、その他軽微なバグを修正したver.1.01にアップデートしました。ご報告ありがとうございました！

notes.title: 【Notice】 BLUE NIGHT LAUNDROMAT Release Date
notes.notes:
Notice.
The release date of BLUE NIGHT LAUNDROMAT will be postponed due to some circumstances.
We hope you can wait a little longer for the release!
However, we will be able to release it by the beginning of November, so please continue to support us!
